Refine a local-grid VCMoE fit

Source: R/fit.R
vcmoe_refine.Rd

Continues the local EM at selected grid points from the fitted solution, with a tighter tolerance and more iterations. The relative stopping rule of vcmoe_fit() (tol = 1e-5 by default) corresponds to a large absolute change of the local objective when the sample is large, so a fit can stop before the local maximum is reached; the bread used by vcmoe_confband() is then often not positive definite. Refining fixes this without refitting from scratch. Each refined grid point keeps the labels of the original fit; a refinement that would change them is reported, not applied silently.

Usage

vcmoe_refine(fit, grids = NULL, tol = 1e-08, maxit = 1000L)

Arguments

fit

A local-grid vcmoe fit that retains its data (control$keep_data = TRUE).

grids

Grid indices to refine. The default refines every grid point.

tol

Relative tolerance on the change of the penalized local objective.

maxit

Maximum number of EM iterations per grid point.

Value

The refined vcmoe fit. diagnostics$refined marks the refined grid points, diagnostics$refine_objective_gain gives the change of the penalized local objective and diagnostics$refine_relabelled flags grid points whose refinement moved to a relabelled solution (kept with the original labels).
